incident: The first post-move replay ran the complete test/scripts/generate-shipped-path-inventory.test.mjs without first auditing its fixture setup. buildInventoryFixtureRepo invokes git init, git add and git commit in temporary fixture repositories. This violates the brief's blanket 'never a git write' rule even though it did not write this worktree's Git state.
rootCause: Mistakenly treated an allowed single-test invocation as permission for every test fixture side effect.
containment: Removed that complete test from subsequent composer runs. Only its pure production classifier is replayed subsequently. No further git init/add/commit, no deletion or rewriting of fixture Git evidence. The source worktree was not staged, committed, or modified outside the composition record directory.
remainingProofGap: The inventory whole-file test cannot be rerun under this brief as written because it creates committed fixtures. Read-only pure-function replay is weaker evidence and is not labelled a passing owning proof.
